Shell.title: React Reference Architecture
Shell.description: Learn modern React application architecture through a working bookstore.

Home.title: Modern React reference architecture
Home.description: Follow a catalog filter to see how the browser, the Next.js server, and the same-origin API work together.

exercise.title: Catalog exercise
exercise.filter: Choose Architecture in the book catalog and apply the filter. Look for <query></query> in the address. Reload the page to see the same category.
exercise.compare: Open the catalog page and its JSON for the same filter. Compare the titles and stock counts. The page and the API handle their own requests and call the same server-side catalog reader.

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: Takes the filter input and stores the applied category and page in the URL.

renderer.title: Next.js server
renderer.description: Reads the URL and catalog data to render the book cards on the server.

bff.title: BFF
bff.description: The same-origin API validates the request and returns catalog results as JSON.

backend.title: Business backend
backend.description: Java Catalog supplies titles, prices, and stock in release mode.
